entities.name: Clinic Management System
entities.description: A hybrid cloud clinical IT solution designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, appointment scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics with high availability and strict regulatory compliance.

entities.name: Front Desk Staff
entities.description: Manages patient admissions, check-ins, and basic scheduling.

entities.name: Clinicians
entities.description: Accesses and updates electronic medical records (EMR) and manages clinical workflows.

entities.name: Billing Specialists
entities.description: Handles financial transactions, insurance claims, and billing operations.

entities.name: Patients
entities.description: Interacts via portal to view records, schedule appointments, and manage billing.

entities.name: Clinic Administrators
entities.description: Oversees clinic operations and administrative tasks.

entities.name: Practice Managers
entities.description: Monitors analytics dashboards and performance metrics.

entities.name: Laboratory Information Systems (LIS)
entities.description: External system for managing laboratory test orders and results.

entities.name: PACS Imaging Archives
entities.description: External system for storing and managing medical imaging data.

entities.name: Insurance Payment Gateways
entities.description: External systems for processing insurance claims and payments.
